name: Plugin Manager
author: Juan Casanueva
description: Enable, disable, place, update, and remove Omarchy shell plugins from the bar

barWidget.description: Manage, place, and update installed Omarchy shell plugins

schema.label: Density
schema.description: How tightly the panel is laid out.

schema.label: Font size
schema.description: Text size, on top of the density's own scaling.

schema.label: Accent colour
schema.description: The colour the panel highlights with: the theme's accent, or a colour from its palette.

schema.label: Show descriptions
schema.description: Show each plugin's description under its name.

schema.label: Show details line (author, kind, version)
schema.description: Show the author, kind and version line under each plugin.

schema.label: Show summary counts in the header
schema.description: Show the installed and update counts under the title.

schema.label: Show key hints
schema.description: Show the keyboard hints at the bottom of the panel.

schema.label: Show the search box
schema.description: Show the search box above the plugin list.
